name: Ashley Heights — additive proposal

entranceBay.basis: Owner: entrance gable protrudes further with rendered walls and piers, a rake band as wide as the piers, no roof overhang, and the glazing inset 500 mm, after the front inspiration image; owner (P8 review): the roof stays at the wing eaves (a raised trial looked too tall); above the door-head transom the glazing is trapezoid panes rising to the rake, and the fascia band under the new roofs is as deep as the walls; owner: the rake band is exactly the roof package deep (0.35 m, measured square to the rake), the upper glazing frame sits 120 mm below the soffit behind a white head packer so it shows from outside, and every frame member in the entrance is 55 mm

garageBay.upper_space: Vaulted window alcove open to the principal suite through the full gable section at floor level; the gable window lights it. Headroom is 2.15 m under the ridge only, so the low sides of the vault are kept off the walking route.
garageBay.basis: Owner: the double garage becomes a lower 1.5-storey wing across the whole south end of the front wing, projecting forward under a wide 30° gable with a window in it, after the front inspiration image

forecourt.planters: raised rendered planters with clipped box and olive trees flanking the entrance
forecourt.basis: Owner: make the forecourt look like the front inspiration image

frontage.basis: Owner: replace the brick piers, plinths and iron railings with a straight boundary wall and a sliding gate flat in the wall line

fountain: remove entire fountain and planted island
frontWingBasis: P5 keeps the P4 main-wing footprint but replaces the east attached anteroom with an open internal garden, reducing the comparison enclosed ground-floor area; original168.134m² target is retained for comparison only and is no longer matched.
structuralChanges: Original front wall/opening alterations allowed by owner; other original rooms/walls/stairs retained. Local loft floor/roof/stair openings necessarily explicit. Original separate model unchanged.

newWingRoof.basis: Owner: extension about 10% smaller; east wall in 0.5 m, eaves to the original 5.35 m, ridge 8.7 m

frontCentralDemolition.scope: Remove original front door, porch, arched landing window and central front wall; direct continuous entrance/landing connection
frontCentralDemolition.preserved: Existing remaining room walls, stair and floor positions

roofBrief: Conventional pitched new wing and central connector with continuous trimmed valleys to original roof. No flat loft bridge; the owner added a flat east dormer over the new-wing loft studio (P8 review). Original rear dormer/pool pavilion/garden living roof remain separate reference-led elements.

internalGarden.basis: P5 owner request: open-to-sky garden immediately outside the retained original drawing-room bay. Complete bay window, masonry, roof and curtains retained. Former east anteroom no longer enclosed floor area.
internalGarden.bayClearanceReason: Straight X10.35 glazing would cut the original western angled bay pane; returned boundary clears its shallow roof by approximately65mm and masonry by more.

enclosedAreaComparison.basis: Same230mm inward-offset isolated envelope comparison as P3; conservative fixed allowance for new glazed boundary, not measured net habitable floor area. Main wing and parking unchanged.

internalGarden.glazingBasis: Owner: the gallery glazing runs straight at x 9.7 instead of returning round the bay; the first floor above is unchanged

areaTargetStatus: Superseded by user-directed internal garden; do not enlarge wing or parking footprint to force equal area.
refinementBrief: Remove secondary dining-bay glass vestibule; former garage becomes open garden living, gym relocated into front wing; continue new-wing roof into original roof; remove orphan rear utility window frames; unify side-wing facade finishes.
bedroomBrief: Six main bedrooms. Repurpose garden-facing north side-wing bedroom as a shared upstairs family lounge with fitted storage and a window-side work table. Preserve all four remaining original bedrooms, the new front principal suite and the south side bedroom.

entertainmentBasement.basis: New northern half of front wing; original wine cellar remains separate. New stair replaces only the ground-floor reading alcove, retaining the entrance/gallery route, gym and garage parking.

frontWingUpperBasis: Owner: the ground floor and garage stay as they are; the first floor and loft come 0.5 m in from the east under a lower roof

wingDormer.basis: Owner: a second flat-roofed dormer on the east slope of the new wing gives the loft studio standing headroom beyond the 2.4 m ridge band. It starts where the east slope soffit meets its 8.12 m ceiling (x 9.51), stops at the studio partition, and its south cheek sits inside the ridge run north of the south hip start (y -16.0).

pavilionBasis: Owner: the glazed pavilion runs the full length of the existing outbuilding row, back to the north end of the outside WC brickwork, and projects 2.22 m (was 2.82 m) in front of it. The tool store and WC doors now open into it.

hotTub.basis: Owner: a double-width 3.4 x 2.3 m unit in place of the 2.3 m square tub; the access stair, timber skirt and pad follow it east.

terraceWalkOnLanterns.basis: Owner: three flush walk-on glass roof lanterns in the terrace over the glazed rear extension, in a row deep in the room clear of the door sweeps and the cafe group.
